layer_3_action.subject: Detailed Layer 2 overlook of the Shaximiao Ancient Jungle
features: High-altitude overlook of a vast green canopy with giant emergent Araucaria
Large Kalligrammatid lacewings (moth-like) fluttering in the foreground sun-shafts
Small gliding mammals (Volaticotherium) silhouetted against the bright foliage
Pterosaurs (Angustinaripterus) perched on thick horizontal boughs, wings spread to the sun
Visible patches of pale mycelium webbing on shadowed nurse-logs in the mid-ground
Brilliant mid-day sun creating high-contrast 'Daggers of Light' through the 'Green Roof'
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic, wide-angle data-collection shot. The scale is massive, but the 'Web of Life' is visible in the small details of insects and gliders. The image is bright, crisp, and scientifically dense.

visuals.fauna_focus: Insects and pterosaurs as ecological indicators
